# gpt2-fsdp-triton

Pretraining GPT-2 small (124M parameters) for one epoch of the FineWeb-Edu 10B-token sample with
PyTorch **DDP and FSDP2** on up to 16 H200 GPUs, with measured **tokens/s and MFU**, a held-out
comparison against OpenAI's GPT-2 124M on identical tokens, zero-shot ARC-Easy, and a fused
**Triton LayerNorm** kernel benchmarked against PyTorch eager and `torch.compile`.

## Results

<!-- headline:start (generated by `gptfsdp report` from the run records; do not edit) -->
- **Pretraining** (one epoch): GPT-2 124M on 9,815,719,936 FineWeb-Edu tokens (18,722 steps of 524,288) with FSDP2 on H200s: 16 GPUs for steps 0–15,250 at 5,709,498 tokens/s (30.8% MFU); 8 GPUs for steps 15,251–18,721 at 3,189,994 tokens/s (34.5% MFU). Final validation loss 3.0814.
- **Held-out loss** on the same 10,485,760 FineWeb-Edu validation tokens: 3.0811 against 3.2924 for OpenAI's GPT-2 124M (step_0018722; the run's training distribution, not GPT-2's).
- **ARC-Easy** (2,376 test questions, zero-shot, one harness for both): acc_norm 0.449 against 0.388 for GPT-2 124M, acc 0.516 against 0.445.
- **Scaling**: DDP on 8 H200 at 92.3% of linear (3,841,266 tokens/s); FSDP2 from one node to two at 99.0% weak-scaling efficiency (6,366,609 tokens/s on 16 GPUs).
- **Triton LayerNorm** (fused forward and backward, 6 shapes): 0.58–2.22× PyTorch eager and 0.81–2.52× `torch.compile` in isolation; inside the compiled model it changes tokens/s by -4.4% (the custom op breaks compile's own fusion), so training uses `nn.LayerNorm`.
<!-- headline:end -->

Every number above and in [`RESULTS.md`](RESULTS.md) is generated by `gptfsdp report` from the
run records in `results/runs/` (config, manifest, JSONL log per run), `baselines/` (GPT-2
evaluations) and `bench/*.json`; nothing is typed by hand. The plan, recipe, metric definitions
and honesty rules are in [`SPEC.md`](SPEC.md). HellaSwag was dropped because its upstream
repository is blocked by a DMCA notice (SPEC section 3).

## Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `src/gptfsdp/model.py` | GPT-2 (pre-LN, tied embeddings, SDPA attention), FLOP accounting |
| `src/gptfsdp/data.py` | `uint16` token shards and the distributed, resumable loader |
| `src/gptfsdp/dist.py` | torchrun process groups; DDP or FSDP2 (`fully_shard`) wrapping |
| `src/gptfsdp/train.py` | training loop, run directory, JSONL logs, throughput and MFU |
| `src/gptfsdp/checkpoint.py` | resume-safe sharded checkpoints (`torch.distributed.checkpoint`) |
| `src/gptfsdp/evaluate.py` | held-out loss for runs and for OpenAI's GPT-2 124M (same tokens) |
| `src/gptfsdp/hellaswag.py` | multiple-choice completion scoring (HellaSwag format; dataset dropped) |
| `src/gptfsdp/arc.py` | ARC-Easy items for that scorer, for runs and for GPT-2 124M |
| `src/gptfsdp/kernels/layernorm.py` | fused LayerNorm forward/backward in Triton |
| `src/gptfsdp/bench.py` | kernel benchmark (eager vs compile vs Triton) |
| `src/gptfsdp/prepare.py` | FineWeb-Edu download and tokenization into shards |
| `src/gptfsdp/report.py` | `RESULTS.md` and the headline above from run logs |
| `slurm/` | Tillicum job scripts (calibration, scaling, chunked full run, finishing, evaluation) |

## Quick start (CPU, tiny model)

```bash
uv sync --extra cpu --extra dev
uv run pytest -q
```

On a GPU node: `uv sync --extra cu130 --extra data`, then see `slurm/`.
